description: Mobile (Android/iOS) permissions for the main window. Desktop-only plugins (updater, process, window-state, mcp-bridge) are NOT compiled on mobile, so their permissions must not appear here or capability validation fails the build. Window controls are OS chrome on mobile, so no drag/maximize/close grants. The fs plugin gets NO grants at all here: every mobile file operation (open, save, search, images) flows through validated Rust commands that confine paths to the app's private storage, so the webview holds no direct filesystem access. SECURITY-02.
